title: EU AI Act Article 55: Post-Market Monitoring Obligations
hook: Article 55 effective 2 August 2026 — monitoring plans required for all high-risk systems
answer_first: Article 55 requires high-risk AI providers to establish proportionate post-market monitoring systems, collect performance data throughout the system lifetime, report serious incidents to market surveillance authorities, and update risk management when new risks emerge. The monitoring plan must form part of Annex IV technical documentation.
council_positioning: Monitored containment, not provable isolation. Verified measurement credential. UK-sovereign, AUKUS-compatible.
sources: EU AI Office Guidance on High-Risk Classification (Sept 2026)
CEN/CENELEC JTC 21 — AI conformity assessment standards
